Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.gitgui

Class GitParsers

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.gitgui.GitParsers
public final class GitParsers extends Object
Pure parsers turning git's machine-readable output into the GitChange / GitCommit / GitBranch models.

Every method is a pure string function - no process, no filesystem - so the whole parse table is unit-testable headless against canned git output.

The parsers take the raw stdout (not pre-trimmed lines) because git's formats are whitespace-significant: git status --porcelain encodes the staged column in character 0 (a leading space means "not staged"), and the log format separates fields with the %x1f unit separator and records with the %x1e record separator rather than newlines.

  • Method Details

    • parseStatus

      public static GitParsers.Status parseStatus(String stdout)
      Parses git status --porcelain=v1 --branch output. The first ## line yields the branch; every other non-blank line is an XY path change, where a rename (R) carries old -> new and the new path is kept.
      Parameters:
      stdout - the raw status output (may be null)
      Returns:
      the parsed status, never null

    • parseBranches

      public static List<GitBranch> parseBranches(String stdout)
      Parses git for-each-ref --format=%(HEAD)%09%(refname:short) output into local branches. A line whose %(HEAD) field is * is the checked-out branch.
      Parameters:
      stdout - the raw for-each-ref output (may be null)
      Returns:
      the branches, never null

    • parseLog

      public static List<GitCommit> parseLog(String stdout)
      Parses git log --pretty=format:%h%x1f%an%x1f%ad%x1f%s%x1e output. Records are split on the %x1e record separator, fields on the %x1f unit separator; a record with fewer than four fields is skipped rather than mis-shown.
      Parameters:
      stdout - the raw log output (may be null)
      Returns:
      the commits, newest first, never null
